newsitem.title: UK: IATA forecasts 6 pct world domestic passenger rise.
newsitem.headline: IATA forecasts 6 pct world domestic passenger rise.

text.p: - World domestic scheduled passenger traffic is expected to average a six percent annual growth rate in 1996-2000 with a peak of 6.7 percent in 1997, the International Air Transport Association (IATA) forecast.

This means that traffic will have grown to nearer 1.2 billion passengers by the end of the decade, from 966 million expected for this year and compared to 919 million in 1995, IATA economist, Francois Dormoy told the organisation's 10th Air Transport Outlook conference.
He said the highest growth rates will be seen in Vietnam with a 20.2 percent average annual rise, followed by Yemen (up 18.9 percent), China (17.9 percent) and the Philippines with 14.5 percent.

A 4.2 percent increase in U.S. domestic traffic will add nearly 114 million passengers to the 1995 total bringing it to over 609 million by 2000. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
